scope: Original real PBF exported by Center, no injected conditions. All represented conditional road edges at four explicit instants. Cold process/cache per query; Busy every other read. Host snapshot policy is the edge oracle. Full-graph host reachability checks completed outcomes; route continuity and active road access checked. No independent shortest-path oracle or board memory measurement. Fixed 32 search/output slots, ALT workspace retained for all algorithms. Relation access polygons are outside road/turn scope.
